hooks.text: 一张魔法卡打开异世界时空之门，与四位性格迥异的女主共同追查灾难并决定终身伴侣。
hooks.excerpt: You are an ordinary young man who accidentally obtains a magical card that opens the gateway to another world, beginning a journey across time and space. In a realm filled with magic and peril, you’ll meet four heroines, each with distinct personalities. Together, you’ll uncover the truth behind the looming catastrophe— and ultimately decide who will spend the rest of their life by your side.
